run.final_summary: Fixed swapped HTB class rates on wan1's WAN uplink (eth2). The business traffic class 1:10 (matching user1's 10.10.10.0/24 prefix) had rate 2Mbit instead of 8Mbit, while best-effort class 1:20 had 8Mbit instead of 2Mbit. Changed class 1:10 to rate 8Mbit ceil 10Mbit and class 1:20 to rate 2Mbit ceil 10Mbit. Validation confirmed all lab connectivity (0% loss on 14 paths) and observed throughput of 7.649 Mbps under contention, exceeding the enforced 6.8 Mbps floor for the 8 Mbps guarantee.
